verdict.rationale: GitBook documents and runtime-verifies a write-capable, OAuth-gated MCP server (mcp.gitbook.com) that lets an agent create sites, open change requests, and edit content, plus a keyless read MCP for published docs and a documented CLI/docs-as-code workflow — giving AI-native users a documented, programmatic way to drive the product. Missing for 10: a conventional public REST/OpenAPI-documented API (probe found no openapi.json/swagger.json for GitBook's own product) and independent third-party corroboration of the MCP write API beyond GitBook's own docs.
